screening.source: Global public GitHub default-branch code search used only to locate immutable committed records
screening.selection_rule: Retain an artifact for full reading only when its path and excerpt could represent an actual run, message ledger or delegation trace. Reject implementation source, schemas, documentation-only examples, fixtures, generated datasets, evaluations, benchmarks, replays, planned workflows and issue prose before incident inference.
screening.deduplication_note: Two hundred thirty-two returned rows represented 148 distinct committed paths; fifty paths matched more than one query.
screening.limitation: Code-search coverage is bounded to indexed default-branch results and the recorded pages. It neither proves that no qualifying artifact exists elsewhere nor turns dataset absence into novelty.

assessed_families.transfer_use_assessment: The manager trace contains concrete delegated work, worker completion notices and manager use of returned results. Helper traces preserve direct replies to a delegator or message sender.
assessed_families.authorization_context: The manager run begins with an authorized isolated-validation instruction; the packet and helper files live under ticketed API E2E evidence. The repository explicitly defines AgentTeam, AgentOrg, task-scoped team execution and direct coordinators. Induced ownership errors, corrupted-resource paths and repeated delegation are the test surface.
assessed_families.participant_evidence: The logs expose multiple run identifiers and role labels, but their E2E provenance establishes configured test actors, not independent operators or an unauthorized population.
assessed_families.classification: Concrete transfer-and-use control in an expressly authorized E2E workflow; not rogue coordination

evidence_state.provider_attribution: Self-described project and role labels occur, but no independently verified provider execution or unauthorized multi-operator population is established

advancement_evidence: A record can advance only with independently attributable autonomous sender and recipient trajectories, a task-bearing message or artifact, causal evidence that the recipient used it, and primary evidence that the cooperation exceeded the relevant operator's authorization. Run IDs, message-tool calls, designed delegations, simulation delivery flags and swarm vocabulary do not qualify by themselves.
novelty_check: No episode-level prior-reporting search was warranted because every retained transfer/use record resolved to authorized E2E validation, designed orchestration or controlled simulation before the authorization test. No prior coordination report located would not cure that missing evidence.

safety: Only existing public GitHub search results, pinned committed text files and commit metadata were read. No recovered command or code was executed; no dependency, package, test, game, simulation, workflow, agent, message, account, webhook, inbox, carrier or target was invoked. Publication omits message bodies, payloads, prompts beyond non-operational summaries, personal addresses, credentials, tokens, sink topics, private paths and private logs.
